scope: Segment-only deterministic simulation, fit on nine normal runs then seal before 28 held-out trials. Same-drift ablation is post-hoc. No statistical confidence claim, trained diagnostic ML, PLC writes, network impairment, full-cycle recovery or productivity superiority.
